build.title: Banner, badge and clock asset types (Fable rebuild)

said.text: Permanent framework asset types: banner (thin bar above the layout, logo, hosts attached assets on left/center/right, plugins attach at run time), badge and clock (attachable, never rolled or picked as slots). Rebuild the engine (core/engines/banner.ts = Kotlin BannerEngine), runtime APIs, React Banner and add the Android Compose banner (not built on Opus). The Opus version is in the framework (Oct 18 2026); keep the asset types and fixtures (spec/fixtures/banner.json) stable for apps that already use them.
